inventory.anchor: EXPORTS.mozilla.gfx (StealthRefuse.h, after the StealthCanvasProjection and StealthRecordedProjection lines)
inventory.notes: Exports StealthRefuse.h, the header-only function by which the engine refuses to run (a declaration missing or malformed): the sentence goes to stderr first, then into the crash.
One include line of StealthDeclarationGate.mozbuild, which exports StealthDeclarationGate.h and StealthGfxFeatureStatus.h and lists their .cpp files.

inventory.anchor: include of StealthGfxFeatureStatus.h; XREMain::XRE_mainRun (right after InitializeUserPrefs)
inventory.notes: Two notices after the profile's preferences are read: StealthMarkUserPrefsRead records that the declaration has arrived, and StealthFireHostGLProbeIfStock fires Mozilla's host GL probe only for a launch with no declaration.

inventory.anchor: after #include "GfxInfoBase.h"; GetFeatureStatus right after the retired-feature check; the top of GetFeatureSuggestedDriverVersion; the top of EvaluateDownloadedBlocklist
inventory.notes: Every graphics feature decision answers from the declared retail statuses (StealthGfxFeatureStatus.cpp), ahead of gfx.blacklist.* prefs, the child cache and the host matcher; the downloaded blocklist is not evaluated and the suggested driver version is empty while declared.

inventory.anchor: after #include "MediaCodecsSupport.h"; the top of FireGLXTestProcess; right after GfxInfoBase::GetData() in GetData
inventory.notes: glxtest, the child that dlopens the host's GL stack, is removed from the Linux build: FireGLXTestProcess spawns nothing (this also covers the early fire in XRE_mainStartup) and GetData fills the test type EGL, no glxtest error, no adapter RAM and the display-protocol flags from our own function, leaving every adapter, driver, DRM and PCI field empty. Our own GL is the only GL; WEBGL_OPENGL answers the declared WEBGL status (StealthGfxFeatureStatus.cpp).

inventory.anchor: SOURCES of widget/gtk (StealthHostGLProbe.cpp, after the list that ends with nsWindow.cpp)
inventory.notes: Registers StealthHostGLProbe.cpp, which fires Mozilla's host GL probe right after the profile's preferences are read; with the engine on it launches nothing and reads nothing from the host.
